description: With `id`, one project: its documents, files and the projects inside it. With `query`, the projects whose name, description or any document mentions those words, each naming its matching documents. With neither, every project you can see. Each answer's `space` says where it lives: private, or a named team; `repo` is the repo it is built from, "" when it has none. Read that repo when you write or check its documents.

query.description: words to look for in projects and their documents

name: find_projects
title: Find projects
